{"metadata":{"description":"为 dsh 打造的自动技能策展插件：每 N 轮真实对话，后台起一个评审子代理阅读会话摘要，主动把值得沉淀的经验提炼为 ~/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md - 把 Hermes 的「后台评审自我改进」闭环移植到 DSH，零侵入 bundle 插件，不改 dsh 源码。","id":"gh:1345620952","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-skill-curator","slug":"runfali/dsh-skill-curator","topics":["dsh","dsh-bundle","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","dsh-skill"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"为 dsh 打造的自动技能策展插件：每 N 轮真实对话，后台起一个评审子代理阅读会话摘要，主动把值得沉淀的经验提炼为 ~/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md - 把 Hermes "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"的「后台评审自我改进」闭环移植到 DSH，零侵入 bundle 插件，不改 dsh 源码。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-skill-curator"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Automatic skill curation for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). After every N real conversation turns (default "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"**3**), the plugin fires a background **subagent** that reads a digest of the session and **edits, m"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"erges, prunes and creates `SKILL.md` files** under the user skills directory (`~/.dsh/skills/`) — th"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"e same self-improvement loop Nous Research's Hermes Agent runs, ported to DSH as a zero-intrusion bu"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"improvement loop Nous Research's Hermes Agent runs, ported to DSH as a zero-intrusion bundle plugin."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Verified host**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime 0.2.2-rc.1` (Node v24); 0.2.1-rc.2 was real-m"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"achine verified end to end (`/skill-refine`).
- **Why the disjunction is load-bearing**: npm semver "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"only satisfies a prerelease from a range group that itself contains a prerelease with the same `[maj"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"or,minor,patch]` tuple, so the plain `<0.2.0` group does **not** cover `0.1.5-rc.1` or `0.1.7-rc.2`,"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" and the `0.2.0-alpha.0` group does **not** cover `0.2.1-rc.2` or `0.2.2-rc.1` (their tuples are new"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"er). `test/entry.test.mjs` pins this with a decision table, a counter-proof (reverting to the older "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"range turns red), and a cross-check against the host's real `semver.satisfies`.
- **0.1.7 settings c"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ontract (what this adaptation was about)**: `settings.installSection` was removed from dsh-settings."},{"id":"p7s9","text":" The namespace **is** the cordis row id, `Config` must be exported from the plugin module, and every"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" live-editable field must be `.volatile()` (the host's `_commitVolatile` rewrites the live reference"},{"id":"p7s11","text":" in place, no fiber restart). The settings card therefore hangs off `configForms.get(ns)` and the `p"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"lugins.item` slot.
- **No install scripts, no gyp/native deps**: the whole tree is plain ESM; `test/"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"entry.test.mjs` guards this (no `install`/`postinstall`/`prepare`, no `optionalDependencies`, depend"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"ency scope limited to `@deepseek-ai/*`)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 compatibility notes"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Verified against the `0.2.2-rc.1` desktop runtime by unpacking its asar and calling the
host's own `"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"evaluatePluginCompatibility`. **0.2.2 breaks nothing this plugin touches —
no source file changed.**"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" The evidence is a method-surface diff against 0.2.1-rc.2, not a
green test run alone:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **`LlmAdapter` surface unchanged** (7 members: `providerInfo`, `providerRetryPolicy`,
`imageReques"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"tPricing`, `imageRequestTarget`, `listModels`, `resolveModel`, `prepareCall`)
— so the 0.2.1-era "ab"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"stract base gained a method" P0 does not recur, and
`src/custom-adapter.js` stands as written.
- **`"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"SubagentRuntime` surface unchanged** (20 members incl. `startActivation`,
`registerProvider`, `list`"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"; still no `start`) — `src/reviewer.js` keeps branching on
"is the method present".
- **Root exports"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" intact**: `settleRunResult`, `attributionHeaders` and `defineTool` are
still exported, and `settleR"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"un` is still absent from the `dsh-subagent` root — the
inlined `src/run-settlement.js` stays the rig"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ht shape, and a run handle still publishes
`{ result, dispose }`.
- **The built-in schemastery moved"},{"id":"p10s9","text":" 3.18.4 → 3.19.0** (`dsh-settings` peer is `~3.19.0`).
Peer widened to `~3.18.4 || ~3.19.0` and the "},{"id":"p10s10","text":"devDependency **pinned to 3.19.0** — the
trap is that pnpm otherwise auto-installs 3.18.4 and every "},{"id":"p10s11","text":"test then validates the old
fixture. `.volatile()` still behaves the same at 3.19.0.
- **The 0.2.2 c"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"lause is load-bearing for install, not for loading.** Against the previous
five-clause range the hos"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"t gate returns PASS at `0.2.2-rc.1` (`includePrerelease`
admits the upper bound's neighbour), while "},{"id":"p10s14","text":"strict semver returns false — so pnpm install
would refuse. `test/entry.test.mjs` pins both the deci"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"sion table and that counter-proof.
- **One stale guard was fixed while here**: the `inject` service-"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"name check resolved a
hardcoded `/usr/lib/node_modules/...` path that never exists on Windows, so it"},{"id":"p10s17","text":" had been
silently skipping (= fake green) since it was written. It now resolves
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-s"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"ettings` / `dsh-tools` from the devDependencies and matches
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 compatibility notes"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Verified against the DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` desktop runtime by comparing against its unpacked
asar sources"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" and by exercising the plugin end-to-end. **0.2.1 packs several breaking
changes** — clearing the co"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"mpatibility gate is not enough on its own:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **The gate is only the entry ticket.** `dsh-subagent` **no longer exports `settleRun`**
from its p"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ackage root (only `settleRunResult`; the implementation moved into
`lib/types/run-settlement.js` but"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" is not reachable through the `exports` map).
A top-level `import { settleRun }` throws a `SyntaxErr"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"or` at **ESM link time**, so
`apply()` never runs and the **entire plugin silently dies** — the host"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" only logs a
single warning. Fix: inline `settleRun` (`src/run-settlement.js`), aligned statement
by"},{"id":"p13s6","text":" statement with the host's semantics.
- **`subagents.start()` was removed** in favour of `startActiv"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"ation(spec)` (whose spec
carries an extra `request` layer). Branch at runtime on "is the method pres"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"ent" rather
than betting on a version number. Note that `startActivation`'s `signal` **covers
admiss"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"ion only** — a timeout must `dispose()` explicitly or the review hangs until the
built-in 15-minute "},{"id":"p13s10","text":"self-timeout.
- **The tool whitelist moved from the `request` layer to the Agent Preset layer.**
`st"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"artLocal` only writes `composition: { agentPreset }`, so locally spawned subagents
never see `reques"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"t.toolFilter`; meanwhile `dsh-tool-subagent` throws outright on
`config.toolFilter` and points you a"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"t a preset. The plugin therefore declares its own
internal preset (`skill-curator-review`) mounting "},{"id":"p13s14","text":"`src/preset-guard.js`, which calls
`tools.restrict({ allow })` inside the subagent's own scope.
- **"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"The preset guard must wait for a readiness marker.** `restrict()` validates names
through `view(scop"},{"id":"p13s16","text":"e).restrictableNames`, which **only accepts the inheritance
surface**; profile entries are created c"},{"id":"p13s17","text":"oncurrently by `Promise.all`, and the preset
row injects only `tools` while this plugin also waits o"},{"id":"p13s18","text":"n `settings` — so the preset
races ahead, the tools are not registered yet, the call throws, and the"},{"id":"p13s19","text":" registry writes
